summary_paragraph: James, a 60-year-old man with a history of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, alcohol use disorder, and tobacco use, was admitted after being found unresponsive in a coffee shop with hypoxia and signs of acute alcohol intoxication. He received intravenous fluids for hypernatremia, a dose of methylprednisolone for COPD exacerbation, and azithromycin for infection prophylaxis. Despite medical recommendations, he refused further treatment, including medications for alcohol withdrawal and morning lab work, and left the hospital against medical advice on the morning of hospital day one.
